text: In early 2026, Anthropic finds itself in a standoff with any lawful purpose, including uses Anthropic has specifically refused to allow, like mass surveillance and autonomous weapons that can choose to attack without a human pulling the trigger. Anthropic is given an ultimatum. Drop the restrictions, or risk losing a government contract with $200 million, potentially being labeled a supply chain risk, a label that could freeze the company out of doing business with the US government altogether. Narrator. For a company built from the very beginning, on the idea that some lines shouldn't be crossed, even under pressure, even at massive financial cost, this is the ultimate test of whether AI safety was ever more than a slogan. How do Dario and Anthropic navigate that fight? We'll say more about the company's true values than any funding round or valuation ever could. And it's a fight that's still unfolding as the story is being told.
